Steps: Open the app. Tap the chat launcher.
Expected result: Chat opens. Header shows the configured title/logo. Composer is visible at the bottom.

Steps: Send 'hi'. Tap the close (X) button. Reopen the chat.
Expected result: Chat closes cleanly. On reopen the earlier messages are still there.

Steps: Kill the app. Open it and the chat straight away.
Expected result: 'Connecting…' shows briefly, then disappears once online. No duplicate messages.

Steps: Turn on airplane mode. Send 'hi'. Turn airplane mode off. Tap the failed message.
Expected result: Offline banner shows. Message shows 'Not sent. Tap to retry'. After tap it sends once and the bot echoes it.

Steps: Send 'text'. Kill the app. Reopen the chat.
Expected result: History loads in the right order. Old messages do NOT animate in again.

Steps: Pull down / use 'new chat' at the top of the list.
Expected result: Screen clears and old history does not come back. Next message starts a fresh session.
Bot lists every test code with a description, plus 4 quick replies.
Bot bubble on the left with the correct theme colours. Timestamp/avatar show if enabled.
*bold* is bold, /italic/ italic, _underline_ underlined, ~strike~ struck through, `code` in a code style. No raw * _ ~ symbols left.
URL, www, bare domain, email and phone are tappable and open the browser / mail app / dialer. TXN20261116 is NOT a link.
Text wraps inside the bubble. The very long word breaks and doesn't overflow sideways. List scrolls to the newest message.
Arabic text is right-aligned, reads right-to-left, numbers display correctly.
All emoji, skin tones, flags and the family emoji show (no empty boxes).
5 messages arrive in order 1-5. No duplicates. List stays at the bottom.
Typing indicator shows while waiting and goes away when the reply arrives.
Notes: If no reply arrives the sandbox has no setTimeout; skip this case

Expected result: User bubble on the right. Shows sending, then sent. Bot echoes it with 'Received:'.
Send button is disabled. Nothing is sent.

Steps: Paste a long paragraph and send.
Expected result: Composer grows up to its max height then scrolls. Sent bubble wraps correctly.

Steps: Tap the composer to open the keyboard. Scroll the list. Close the keyboard.
Expected result: Composer stays above the keyboard. Latest message stays visible. No blank gap after the keyboard closes.
Notes: Check on both a notch and a non-notch device

Steps: Tap attach, pick a photo from the gallery.
Expected result: Thumbnail shows while uploading, then sent. Bot echoes the image message.

Steps: Attach a file bigger than maxAttachmentMB.
Expected result: File is rejected with a clear error. Nothing is sent.
3 chips show. Tapping sends 'Option two' as a user bubble. Chips go away. Bot echo shows reply_id 'opt_2'.
Notes: Check the echo includes replyIdExt too

Expected result: All 8 chips are visible (wrap or scroll) and each one can be tapped.
Long labels wrap or truncate neatly inside the chip. 'OK' chip is not stretched.
URL chip has a link look. Opens the browser and does NOT send a message. The other chip still sends normally.

Steps: Type 'btn', then type 'text'. Look at the older 'Pick one' message.
Expected result: Chips only show on the latest bot message. Old chips can't be tapped.

Steps: Type 'form1'. Enter 'abc'. Then enter 'qa@example.com' and submit.
Expected result: Email card shows. 'abc' shows an invalid email error. A valid email submits and the bot echo shows it.

Steps: Type 'form3'. Fill name, email, phone. Submit.
Expected result: Card shows Full name, Email, Mobile number. Submit sends all 3. Bot echo shows name, email and phone.
Phone is sent with the dial code and the leading 0 removed (+91 9876543210).

Steps: Type 'form1'. Instead of the card, type 'qa@example.com' in the composer. Then repeat with 'abc'.
Expected result: Valid email goes as form.email (check the echo). 'abc' shows the invalid email error.
'hi' is sent as plain text, not as the email field.
No form card is shown. Only the text bubble.
Email card and 'Skip' chip both show. Skip sends reply_id 'skip'.

Steps: Type 'img'. Tap the image. Pinch to zoom. Swipe down.
Expected result: Space is reserved before it loads (no jump). Caption shows. Viewer opens, zooms and closes on swipe down.
Image is sized to fit and is not stretched or cropped badly.
A placeholder/error state shows. App does not crash. Caption still shows.
Image still loads (SDK switches it to https).

Steps: Type 'video'. Tap play. Close the player.
Expected result: Video tile with play icon. Plays in the viewer with sound. Closes cleanly.

Steps: Type 'audio'. Play, pause, play again. Then send 'audio' again and play the second one.
Expected result: Play/pause and progress work. Starting the second clip stops the first.
File row shows the name 'test-invoice.pdf' and an icon. Tapping opens or downloads the PDF.

Steps: Ask the backend team for a reply with mediaSubType BG_VOICE.
Expected result: Audio plays without a bubble. Respects features.backgroundAudio.
Notes: No scriptus payload known yet; BLOCKED

Expected result: 'Connecting you to an agent…' shows. The agent's reply shows as a bot-side bubble.
Closing message shows. Next message starts a new session and the bot answers.

Steps: Set TEMPLATE_CODE in the bot. Type 'template'.
Expected result: Template text (and its buttons, if any) show correctly.

Steps: In the example app, switch Minimal, Ocean, Midnight, Arabic. Type 'menu' in each.
Expected result: Colours, bubble/chip radius and header brand image (left/center/right) match the preset.

Steps: Switch the phone to dark mode. Type 'btn'.
Expected result: Dark colours apply. Text, chips and composer are readable.

Steps: Set the phone font size to the max. Type 'long'.
Expected result: Text grows up to the max scale. Nothing is clipped. Header and composer still fit.

Steps: Use the Arabic preset (ar-KW). Open the chat.
Expected result: Header, placeholder and status strings are Arabic. Layout is right-to-left.
